content_sections.heading: About NEIAH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: North Eastern Institute of Ayurveda & Homoeopathy (NEIAH) is an autonomous institute established under the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India. It is situated at Mawdiangdiang, Shillong, Meghalaya – 793018, providing education, healthcare, and research facilities in Ayurveda and Homoeopathy systems of medicine.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets, testimonials, two recent passport size photographs, and the requisite Demand Draft (where applicable) must reach the following postal address on or before 07 December 2026: The Director, North Eastern Institute of Ayurveda & Homoeopathy (NEIAH), Mawdiangdiang, Shillong, Meghalaya – 793018 The envelope containing the application form must be superscribed with “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________________ Sl No.________”. Applications are accepted strictly through Speed Post, Registered Post, or by depositing into the designated Drop Box at the institute. Applications sent by courier will not be accepted. Candidates applying for the post of Nursing Officer must pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- in the form of a Bank Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favour of "Director, North Eastern Institute of Ayurveda & Homoeopathy" payable at Shillong. On the reverse side of the Demand Draft, candidates must write their name, category, and the post applied for. Persons with Disabilities (PWD/PH) and applicants applying on deputation are exempt from paying any application fee. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Mode of Recruitment: Deputation. Age Limit: Not exceeding 56 years on the closing date of receipt of application. Essential Qualification & Experience: Degree of a recognized university, with 10 years experience in Administration/Establishment out of which 5 years should be in a supervisory capacity. Desirable: Degree/PG Diploma in Management. Deputation Terms: Persons from Central/State Government/Autonomous bodies holding an analogous post; or with 5 years service in Grade Pay of Rs. 5,400; or with 7 years service in Grade Pay of Rs. 4,800/4,600; and possessing the educational qualifications mentioned above. Mode of Recruitment: Deputation. Age Limit: Not exceeding 56 years on the closing date of receipt of application. Educational Qualification: A Degree from a recognized university. Desirable: Experience and knowledge of office procedure and general administration. Deputation Terms: Persons from Central/State Government departments/Autonomous organizations holding an analogous post; or with 6 years regular service in Grade Pay of Rs. 2,800; or 10 years in Grade Pay of Rs. 2,400; and possessing the qualification and experience mentioned above. Mode of Recruitment: By Direct Recruitment failing which by deputation. Age Limit: Not exceeding 30 years on the closing date of receipt of application. Essential Qualification (any one of the following): B.Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing from an Indian Nursing Council recognized institute or University, OR Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from an Indian Nursing Council recognized institute or University; AND registered as a Nurse or Nurse & Midwife with State/Indian Nursing Council; OR B.Sc Nursing (AYUSH) from an AYUSH recognized Institute/University; AND registered in the respective State/Indian AYUSH Nursing Council; OR Diploma in General Nursing Midwifery from an Indian Nursing Council recognized Institute/Board or Council; AND registered as Nurse or Nurse & Midwife in State/Indian Nursing Council; AND two years experience in a minimum 25-bedded Hospital after acquiring the educational qualification; OR Diploma in Nursing & Pharmacy of AYUSH and registered in the respective State/Indian AYUSH Nursing Council; AND two years experience in a minimum 25-bedded Hospital after acquiring the educational qualification. Age relaxation and reservation benefits are admissible to SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PWD, and serving government employees in accordance with orders issued by the Central Government from time to time. Candidates claiming relaxation must produce valid original certificates in the prescribed Government of India format at the time of interview. OBC candidates must produce a latest Non-Creamy Layer Certificate.

rows.pay: Level-7 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 44,900–1,42,400) PB-II Rs. 9,300–34,800 with GP of Rs. 4,600 (pre-revised)

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach the following documents with their completed application form: Self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets in support of educational and professional qualifications. Self-attested copy of proof of date of birth. Self-attested copies of experience certificates (issued on organization letterhead, mentioning date of issue, engagement duration, pay level/last pay, nature of work handled, and signature with name and designation of the issuing authority). Valid Caste/Community/PWD/EWS certificate issued by a competent authority, if applicable. Relevant Nursing Council Registration Certificate (for Nursing Officer applicants). Teacher’s Code (if applicable). Two recent passport size photographs (one affixed on the application form and self-attested). Original Bank Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- (for Nursing Officer applicants). For candidates serving in Government/Autonomous/Statutory bodies: Application forwarded through proper channel, along with an original 'No Objection Certificate' (NOC) to be produced at the interview. For deputation applicants: Duly verified particulars, attested copies of ACRs/APARs for at least the latest 5 years, and a Vigilance Clearance Certificate stating no disciplinary proceedings are pending or contemplated.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened based on the essential eligibility criteria. The selection process involves: Shortlisting of eligible candidates based on the prescribed qualifications and requirements. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test, skill test, or interview as deemed fit by the Institute. Candidates must appear for the test/interview at their own expense; no travel allowance will be provided. Final appointment is subject to medical fitness certified by the Competent Medical Board/Medical Authority prior to joining.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: If the closing date happens to be an official holiday, the next working day will be treated as the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in NEIAH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies are available, comprising 1 post of Deputy Director (Administration), 1 post of Assistant Administrative Officer, and 2 posts of Nursing Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application for NEIAH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of completed applications at NEIAH Shillong is 07 December 2026 (or the next working day if it falls on a holiday).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Nursing Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing (AYUSH) with relevant council registration, or a Diploma in GNM / AYUSH Nursing & Pharmacy with council registration and 2 years experience in a minimum 25-bedded hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the posts in NEIAH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 30 years for Nursing Officer, and not exceeding 56 years for Deputy Director (Administration) and Assistant Administrative Officer, calculated as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Nursing Officer post at NEIAH?
faq.answer: The Nursing Officer post carries Level-7 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 44,900–1,42,400) (pre-revised PB-II Rs. 9,300–34,800 with Grade Pay of Rs. 4,600).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NEIAH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Nursing Officer must pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- via Bank Demand Draft drawn in favour of "Director, North Eastern Institute of Ayurveda & Homoeopathy" payable at Shillong.

faq.question: Q7. Who is exempt from paying the application fee in NEIAH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Persons with Disabilities (PWD/PH) and candidates applying for posts filled on a deputation basis are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Can the application for NEIAH Recruitment 2026 be sent by courier?
faq.answer: No, applications sent by courier will not be accepted; they must be sent exclusively by Speed Post, Registered Post, or deposited in the designated Drop Box at the institute.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected for the posts under NEIAH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on eligibility criteria and then called for a written test, skill test, or interview as decided by the Institute, followed by a medical fitness examination.
